card.breath.sama-vritti.title: Equal breathing
card.breath.sama-vritti.body: Breathe in for 4 and out for 4, smooth and quiet. A steady way to start.

card.breath.deergha.title: Three-part breath
card.breath.deergha.body: Fill the belly, ribs, then chest. Let the out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath.

card.breath.nadi-shodhana.title: Alternate-nostril breathing
card.breath.nadi-shodhana.body: In through one nostril, out through the other. Gentle, with no breath-holding.

card.breath.bhramari.title: Humming-bee breath
card.breath.bhramari.body: Breathe in, then hum softly as you breathe out. As quiet as you like.

card.stillness.breath.title: Sit with the breath
card.stillness.breath.body: Let the breath move on its own. When the mind wanders, come back to the next breath.

card.stillness.body-scan.title: Body scan
card.stillness.body-scan.body: Move your attention slowly from your feet to the top of your head. Notice; there is nothing to fix.

card.stillness.repetition.title: Silent repetition
card.stillness.repetition.body: Repeat a word or name you hold dear with each breath, or use so'ham.

card.reflect.one-word.title: One word for today
card.reflect.one-word.body: Write one word for how you feel right now. Just one.

card.reflect.gratitude.title: One thing you're grateful for
card.reflect.gratitude.body: Write one line about something, or someone, you're grateful for today.

card.reflect.intention.title: Set one intention
card.reflect.intention.body: Write one small thing you mean to do today, and how you'd like to do it.

card.reflect.notice.title: Notice one thing
card.reflect.notice.body: What did you notice during your practice? A sound, a thought, a feeling. Write it down.

card.reflect.kindness.title: A small kindness
card.reflect.kindness.body: Think of one small kindness you could offer someone today. Write who, and what.
